Title: SQL Server 2019 is now generally available

Body.Content:
SQL Server 2019 enables you to gain intelligence over all your data, both structured and unstructured, by combining the power of the new big data clusters capability with enhanced data virtualization.

Go to the official Microsoft SQL Server web page
